author: Micka420-collab

scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run preparer-ruche && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run preparer-ruche && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --publish never
